review: Independent source/core review of bounded MPE onset retention
approval: Production source and focused core test approved; not full qualification or publication approval
source_findings: All caches accept only finite clamped events for actual member roles while effective MPE is enabled.
Pressure stored before curve; bend before range multiplication. Accepted onset maps current configuration once, without replaying global event side effects.
Engine reset and MPE mode edges clear state; role-changing negotiation invalidates previous role ownership. Same-role MCM retains raw state and onset uses current range.
Existing active event routes, voice-age smoothing, poly-pressure, manager/gap, PURE and non-MPE paths are not rewritten.
Cache is fixed size and audio-owned; no new heap allocation, locks, per-sample loop or host/preset state is introduced by the inspected code.

independent_execution.build_check: CMake/Ninja target dry run reported no work to do

limits: This review did not independently run broader suites, Clang/native profiles, sanitizer or native processor/wrapper tests.
The paired behavioral reference uses ordinary same-boundary controller events within the candidate; it is not an unchanged-baseline compatibility proof.
Post-Note-Off tail isolation, full zone-reset behavior, manager/member combination, inactive-extension state handoff and external MIDI/DAW conformance remain outside this increment.
No cost timing, realtime deadline, circuit-fidelity or full MPE-compliance claim.
